## Why sample TCGA-A1-A0SH-01 was selected

This vignette demonstrates OmicsKit functions for multi-omics genomic tracks,
circos visualization, and RNA-RPPA concordance using real TCGA-BRCA-derived
example data.

The sample `TCGA-A1-A0SH-01` was selected because it has the layers needed for
a compact multi-omics track example: RNA-seq expression, SNP6 copy-number
segments, HumanMethylation450 beta values, and MC3 mutation calls. It is also
documented in the prepared object notes as carrying a BRCA1 nonsense mutation,
`p.Q934*`, making the BRCA1 region useful for an interpretable track example.

The heavy layer preparation is done in `data-raw/brca/07_prepare_omics_layer_objects_brca.R`.
This vignette does not regenerate BigWig or BED files.

```{r packages}
library(OmicsKit)
```

```{r load_objects}
data(brca_omics_layer_tracks)
data(brca_concordance_rna_rppa_er)
data(brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er)

brca_omics_layer_tracks$sample_id
brca_omics_layer_tracks$genome_build
brca_omics_layer_tracks$brca1_region_hg38
```

## BRCA1 region and available omics layers

The main genomic window is the BRCA1 region in hg38. The track files stored in
`inst/extdata/brca/omics_layers/` are project/package assets prepared from real
TCGA-BRCA inputs and are referenced with `system.file()` when used from an
installed package.

```{r track_inventory}
track_files <- unlist(brca_omics_layer_tracks$track_files)

data.frame(
  track = names(track_files),
  file = basename(track_files),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r system_file_paths, eval = FALSE}
rna_bw <- system.file(
  "extdata/brca/omics_layers/TCGA-A1-A0SH-01_rna_expr_hg38.bw",
  package = "OmicsKit"
)
cnv_bw <- system.file(
  "extdata/brca/omics_layers/TCGA-A1-A0SH-01_cnv_hg38.bw",
  package = "OmicsKit"
)
cnv_bed <- system.file(
  "extdata/brca/omics_layers/TCGA-A1-A0SH-01_cnv_hg38.bed",
  package = "OmicsKit"
)
methyl_brca1_bw <- system.file(
  "extdata/brca/omics_layers/TCGA-A1-A0SH-01_methyl_brca1_hg38.bw",
  package = "OmicsKit"
)
mutation_bed <- system.file(
  "extdata/brca/omics_layers/TCGA-A1-A0SH-01_mutations_brca1_hg38.bed",
  package = "OmicsKit"
)
```

## nice_GenomeTrack()

`nice_GenomeTrack()` renders a regional genomic view with a coordinate axis,
gene annotation, and optional data tracks. For this example, RNA-seq, CNV,
methylation 450k, and mutation tracks are shown around BRCA1.

The example call below uses `system.file()` to resolve package-installed files.
It is marked `eval = FALSE` because reading BigWig/BED tracks and rendering
Gviz tracks is heavier than a normal vignette build should be.

```{r nice_genometrack_call, eval = FALSE}
brca1_region <- brca_omics_layer_tracks$brca1_region_hg38

brca1_annotation <- data.frame(
  geneID = "ENSG00000012048",
  symbol = "BRCA1",
  chromosome = "17",
  gene_start = 43044295,
  gene_end = 43125483,
  strand = "-",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

nice_GenomeTrack(
  region = brca1_region,
  genome_label = "hg38",
  organism = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl",
  ensembl_version = "current",
  annotations = brca1_annotation,
  tracks = list(
    `RNA-seq` = rna_bw,
    CNV = cnv_bw,
    `Methylation 450k` = methyl_brca1_bw,
    Mutations = mutation_bed
  ),
  highlight_genes = "BRCA1"
)
```

```{r genome_track_figure, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Sample-specific TCGA-BRCA omics tracks around BRCA1 for TCGA-A1-A0SH-01. Tracks were prerendered from real RNA-seq, CNV, methylation 450k, and mutation files.", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/brca_genome_track_brca1_TCGA-A1-A0SH-01.png")
```

## nice_circos()

`nice_circos()` displays genome-wide omics tracks in circular coordinates. The
BRCA example uses binned RNA-seq and methylation tracks, CNV segments, and the
BRCA1-region mutation BED file prepared for `TCGA-A1-A0SH-01`.

This plotting call is also shown as non-executed code. It reads genomic track
files and creates a device-level circular plot, so the vignette displays the
real prerendered figure instead.

```{r nice_circos_call, eval = FALSE}
rna_1mb_bed <- system.file(
  "extdata/brca/omics_layers/TCGA-A1-A0SH-01_rna_expr_1Mb_hg38.bed",
  package = "OmicsKit"
)
methyl_1mb_bed <- system.file(
  "extdata/brca/omics_layers/TCGA-A1-A0SH-01_methyl_450k_meanBeta_1Mb_hg38.bed",
  package = "OmicsKit"
)

nice_circos(
  genome_build = "hg38",
  data_tracks = list(
    `RNA-seq` = list(path = rna_1mb_bed, type = "histogram"),
    CNV = list(path = cnv_bed, type = "line"),
    `Methylation 450k` = list(path = methyl_1mb_bed, type = "points"),
    Mutations = list(path = mutation_bed, type = "mutation")
  ),
  ideogram = FALSE,
  chromosome_index = paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y")),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_labels = TRUE
)
```

```{r circos_figure, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Genome-wide circos view for TCGA-A1-A0SH-01 using real prepared BRCA RNA-seq, CNV, methylation 450k, and mutation tracks.", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 7}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/brca_circos_TCGA-A1-A0SH-01.png")
```

## concordanceDE()

`concordanceDE()` compares differential results across two omics layers. In
this BRCA example, RNA-seq and gene-level RPPA limma results are compared for
the same ER-positive vs ER-negative primary tumor contrast.

The prepared object uses:

- `gene_col = "gene"`
- `logfc_col = "logFC"`
- `padj_col = "padj"`
- `padj_threshold = 0.05`
- `logfc_threshold = c(1, 0.20)`

The two log-fold-change thresholds reflect the different scales of RNA-seq and
RPPA measurements.

```{r concordance_summary}
brca_concordance_rna_rppa_er$concordance_score
brca_concordance_rna_rppa_er$summary
```

```{r concordance_call, eval = FALSE}
brca_concordance_rna_rppa_er <- concordanceDE(
  de_x = brca_rna_dea_er_pos_vs_er_neg,
  de_y = brca_rppa_dea_gene_er_pos_vs_er_neg,
  gene_col = "gene",
  logfc_col = "logFC",
  padj_col = "padj",
  padj_threshold = 0.05,
  logfc_threshold = c(1, 0.20)
)
```

## crossLayerCorr()

`crossLayerCorr()` estimates sample-level concordance between paired omics
profiles. Here it compares RNA and RPPA values across shared genes and shared
samples for the ER-positive vs ER-negative prepared subset, using Spearman
correlation.

```{r crosslayer_summary}
data.frame(
  median_spearman_r = brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er$median_r,
  n_shared_samples = brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er$n_shared_samples,
  n_shared_features = brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er$n_shared_features,
  n_features_used = brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er$n_features_used
)
```

```{r crosslayer_call, eval = FALSE}
brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er <- crossLayerCorr(
  mat_x = brca_rna_expr_er_shared_filtered,
  mat_y = brca_rppa_expr_gene_er_shared,
  method = "spearman",
  top_n = 146,
  plot = TRUE
)
```

```{r crosslayer_figure, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Sample-level Spearman correlation between RNA-seq and RPPA profiles across shared genes in TCGA-BRCA ER-status samples.", fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/brca_crosslayercorr_rna_rppa_er.png")
```

## nice_ConcordanceScatter()

`nice_ConcordanceScatter()` visualizes the `concordanceDE()` result as a
log-fold-change scatter plot. Each point is a shared gene, colored by whether
the RNA and RPPA effects are concordant, discordant, layer-specific, or not
significant.

The plotting call is inexpensive compared with track rendering, but the
vignette still displays the prerendered figure so the visual output is stable.

```{r concordance_scatter_call, eval = FALSE}
nice_ConcordanceScatter(
  brca_concordance_rna_rppa_er,
  x_label = "RNA-seq log2FC",
  y_label = "RPPA log2FC",
  genes_label = c("ESR1", "ERBB2", "PGR", "GATA3"),
  method = "spearman",
  logfc_col = "logFC"
)
```

```{r concordance_scatter_figure, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "RNA-RPPA differential concordance for TCGA-BRCA ER-positive vs ER-negative primary tumors.", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
knitr::include_graphics("figures/brca_concordance_scatter_rna_rppa_er.png")
```

## Reproducibility

The raw omics-layer files are prepared outside the vignette and stored under
`inst/extdata/brca/omics_layers/`. The package-ready metadata object
`brca_omics_layer_tracks` records the sample ID, genome build, BRCA1 plotting
region, track labels, file paths, and notes about provenance and liftOver.

```{r session_info}
sessionInfo()
```
